Within the context of this corpus, Governance refers to the administrative oversight and collaborative development of clinical quality metrics. The primary governance actor identified is the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee), which directs the creation and refinement of clinical indicators. In a specific governance action, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] established a dedicated working group to develop a new quality indicator focused on patient nutrition [^src1]. This development was conducted in formal collaboration with the [[dansk-selskab-for-klinisk-ernaering|Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring]] (Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition) [^src1]. The initiative is directly linked to [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]], highlighting the structural process through which new clinical metrics are proposed and integrated into the broader quality assessment framework [^src1]. 

The available evidence for this governance topic is thin, consisting of a single claim regarding the formation of this specific working group. No further details regarding broader governance policies, additional committee members, or the final outcome of the indicator development are available in the current data.

## Claims
- Styregruppen har nedsat en arbejdsgruppe til udvikling af en ny kvalitetsindikator for ernæring i samarbejde med Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring [^src1] (styregruppen, dansk-selskab-for-klinisk-ernaering, indikator-7)
